codes.DEMO_ALL_ADMINS: Every demo user is a tenant administrator already – restart the demo to try again.
codes.CHANGE_SUMMARY_REQUIRED: Summarise what changed in this edition.
codes.CHANGE_SUMMARY_TOO_LONG: The change summary is too long (at most {{max}} characters).
codes.DOCUMENT_NO_EDITION: {{number}} has no approved edition yet: there is nothing to review.
codes.DOCUMENT_UPDATE_REQUESTED: A review found that {{number}} needs an update. The review stays due until the next edition is approved.
codes.EDITION_KIND_REQUIRED: Choose whether this is a minor (editorial) or a major (substantive) edition.
codes.REVIEW_DATE_LATER: The next review can only be set earlier than planned ({{date}}).
codes.REVIEW_DATE_PAST: The next review cannot be in the past.
codes.FORBIDDEN_reviewDocument: You are not allowed to review this document (its owner and review owner, approvers and administrators are).
codes.FORBIDDEN_reviewSettings: You are not allowed to change the review settings of this document.
codes.FORBIDDEN_reviewOwner: Only approvers and administrators choose the review owner of a document.
codes.FORBIDDEN_reviewOwnerSelf: Four-eyes principle: you own or wrote this document, so you cannot make yourself its review owner. An administrator can.
codes.FORBIDDEN_reviewInterval: Only approvers and administrators change the review interval of a document.
codes.FORBIDDEN_reviewIntervalAdmin: Only administrators turn off the periodic reviews of a document or plan them less often than its type does.
codes.FORBIDDEN_reviewDateLater: Only approvers and administrators remove a planned review date or move it later.
codes.PASSWORD_LOGIN_OFF: Password sign-in is turned off (single sign-on only) – this is not possible.
codes.PASSWORD_LOGIN_FROM_ENV: Password sign-in is set on the server with SM_PASSWORD_LOGIN={{value}}.
codes.SSO_PROVIDER_REQUIRED: Enable a single sign-on provider before turning off password sign-in.
codes.SSO_ADMIN_REQUIRED: Sign in with single sign-on as an administrator first – then you know that at least one administrator can still get in.
codes.EMERGENCY_CODE_INVALID: This emergency access link is invalid, used or expired – run the command on the server again.
codes.EMERGENCY_REQUEST_REFUSED: Emergency access can only be granted on the server itself, with the master passphrase.
codes.EMERGENCY_WINDOW_INVALID: The window must be 1 to 1440 minutes.
codes.EMERGENCY_NO_TOKENS: API tokens cannot be created in an emergency access session.
codes.EMERGENCY_NOT_ALLOWED: This is not possible in an emergency access session.
codes.MIGRATION_AUDIT_UNVERIFIED: The audit log does not verify – no package is made (see Audit log → Verify).
codes.MIGRATION_BLOCKED: This package cannot be imported here (see the dry run).
codes.MIGRATION_BUSY: Another package is being imported – finish or discard it first.
codes.MIGRATION_EXPORT_GONE: The package is gone – export again.
codes.MIGRATION_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: The confirmed fingerprint does not match the package.
codes.MIGRATION_MAPPING_INVALID: The identity mapping cannot be applied – see the problems listed.
codes.MIGRATION_NO_SIGNING_KEY: The vault has no signing key – unlock it once with this version.
codes.MIGRATION_PACKAGE_INVALID: The package is damaged or not valid.
codes.MIGRATION_PACKAGE_NEWER: The package was made by a newer version – update this instance first.
codes.MIGRATION_PACKAGE_UNREADABLE: Wrong transfer passphrase, or the package was changed or is incomplete.
codes.MIGRATION_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The package signature is invalid – it was changed after the export.
codes.MIGRATION_SOURCE_IMPORTED: This instance holds imported history from an earlier move – moving it again is not supported yet.
codes.MIGRATION_STAGED_GONE: The uploaded package is gone – upload it again.
codes.MIGRATION_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY: Files of the package exist in the data folder already.
codes.TRANSFER_PASSPHRASE_TOO_SHORT: The transfer passphrase must have at least {{count}} characters.
codes.USERNAME_IS_ALIAS: "{{username}}" is the former name of an imported account.
codes.SSO_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN: Choose an enabled single sign-on provider.
codes.SSO_PROVIDER_CHOICE_REQUIRED: Choose the single sign-on provider the account signs in with.
codes.SSO_ALREADY_BOUND: This account signs in with single sign-on already.

boundary.title: Something went wrong on this page
boundary.text: The page could not be displayed. Your data is not affected. Try again, go to another page or reload the application.
